description: Generic common nouns Natasha NER mistags as ORG — name no specific entity. Not PII: "Интернет", "Сервер" and the like are common nouns, not organizations. Matched as word-by-word lemma keys, so declensions are covered, and only a bare single-word span is dropped (a real org like "Почта России" reduces to a different key and stays detected). To extend: add another generic noun that NER mislabels as an entity.
